title: Effects of Forward and Backward Span Trainings on Working Memory: Evidence from a Randomized, Controlled Trial
description: This dataset contains EEG/ERP recordings from a randomized controlled trial comparing forward span training, backward span training, and no-intervention control groups on working memory. Recordings were collected at pre-, mid-, and post-test while participants performed a distractor version of the change detection task, and behavioral data were collected from additional change detection and suppress tasks. The data support analyses of working memory maintenance and interference control, indexed by Kmax and contralateral delay activity (CDA).
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel Synamps RT system (Neuroscan) at pre-, mid-, and post-test sessions. Participants sat in a darkened, electrically shielded chamber with impedance below 5 kΩ and the reference on the left mastoid. Vertical and horizontal EOG were recorded. The task was a distractor version of change detection with 2T0D, 4T0D, and 2T2D conditions.
